movelist.name: Astonish
movelist.effect: Astonish Flinches the target on 15+. Once per scene, if the target is unaware of the user’s presence, Astonish automatically Flinches the target.

movelist.name: Sand Tomb
movelist.effect: The target is put in a Vortex.

movelist.name: Absorb
movelist.effect: After the target takes damage, the user gains Hit Points equal to half of the damage they dealt to the target.

movelist.name: Sand Attack
movelist.effect: The target is Blinded until the end of their next turn.

movelist.name: Harden
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Defense 1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Mega Drain
movelist.effect: After the target takes damage, the user gains Hit Points equal to half of the damage they dealt to the target.

abilities.name: Water Compaction
abilities.effect: The user gains a +2d6+4 bonus on damage rolls against foes that were released from a Pokéball or entered the encounter since the user's last turn.

abilities.name: Arena Trap
abilities.effect: Once Arena Trap is activated, all foes within 5 meters of the user are considered Slowed and Trapped. This does not affect targets of the Flying Type, or with a Levitate, Sky, or Burrow Speed of 4 or higher. The user may end the effect as a Free Action, and the effect ends if the user is Fainted or returned to a Poké Ball.
